name: scratch-card
summary: Rub a shimmering foil away; past a threshold the rest clears with a haptic tap.
props: The reward underneath; it sets the card's size.
Screen-reader hint on the foil; pass your own to translate it.
Share of the foil to scratch before the rest clears.
Controlled: true shows the reward, false puts the foil back.
Finger down / up — e.g. pause a parent ScrollView.
Clear the foil, or put a fresh one on.
behavior: Your finger scratches the foil away with a round brush, and once threshold of it is gone the rest clears by itself. The card keeps the touch, so a parent ScrollView cannot steal it mid-rub.
A light band sweeps across the foil until the first touch. On reveal the foil fades out while scaling up slightly.
A success notification plays when the foil clears.
The foil is a button labelled with label and sublabel, with the hint revealHint (default 'Double-tap to reveal').
